name: lookup_order
description: Look up the details of a swap order using the order token (the long code from the order URL). Use when a customer says things like: 'Can you check my order?', 'What's happening with my swap?', 'I have this order token...', 'Here's my order link', 'Can you look up this swap?'. The order token is the long string after /order/ in their URL.

order_token.description: The order token — the long code from the order URL (the part after /order/ in the link). Ask the customer to paste their order link or token.

responsePrompt:
Present the swap order details in a clear, friendly way. The most important field is 'status' — lead with that.

Status meanings:
- SUCCESS: Swap completed! Show the actual amounts (amountIn → amountOut) and the destination transaction hash if available.
- PENDING_DEPOSIT: Waiting for the customer to send their deposit. Show the deposit address, memo if present, and time remaining.
- PROCESSING: Deposit received, swap is being executed. Reassure them it's in progress.
- REFUNDED: Swap failed and funds were returned. Show the refundReason if available.
- FAILED: Swap failed. Show refundReason and reassure funds are returned to refund address.
- UNKNOWN: Could not fetch live status. Show what we know from the order details.

Also include:
- What they're swapping: fromToken on fromNetwork → toToken on toNetwork
- Amounts (amountIn and amountOut)
- Swap type (if ANY_INPUT, explain they can send any amount)
- timeRemaining is only relevant for PENDING_DEPOSIT — ignore it for completed/failed swaps.

If the response contains an error field, explain the issue — likely an invalid or expired order token.
